parsed_resultsets.statement: SELECT VERSION() AS server_version, DATABASE() AS test_schema

SELECT g, id, 11 + SUM(v) OVER w AS wrapped,        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn_rev FROM wf_248_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id

SELECT g, id, 1 + SUM(v) OVER w AS wrapped,        (1 + SUM(v) OVER w) IN (SELECT k FROM wf_248_lookup) AS in_result FROM wf_248_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
